724: static bool wifi_sync_reset_generation(void)
725: {
726:   struct wifi_pending_node nodes[WIFI_NODE_QUEUE];
727:   uint32_t generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
728:   bool wake_command = false;
729:   unsigned int kept = 0;
730:   unsigned int i;
731:   irqstate_t flags;
732: 
733:   if (generation == g_wifi.reset_generation)
734:     {
735:       return false;
736:     }
737: 
738:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
739:   if (g_wifi.waiting_id != 0)
740:     {
741:       g_wifi.command_result = -ECONNRESET;
742:       g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
743:       wake_command = true;
744:     }
745: 
746:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
747:   if (wake_command)
748:     {
749:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
750:     }

753:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
754:   wifi_scan_cache_clear();
755:   g_wifi.scan_running = false;
756:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
757: 
758:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
759:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
760:   generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
761: 
762:   /* A peer generation change proves the old CP can no longer reference AP
763:    * command slots.  TX slots remain quarantined because DMA completion is
764:    * not proven by a CP reset.
765:    */
766: 
767:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
768:     {
769:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
770:           g_wifi.command[i].generation != generation)
771:         {
772:           *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes =
773:             BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
774:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
775:           g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending = false;
776:         }
777:     }
778:   g_wifi.reset_generation = generation;
779:   for (i = 0; i < g_wifi.node_count; i++)
780:     {

782: 
783:       if (g_wifi.nodes[index].generation == generation)
784:         {

786:         }
787:     }

789:   g_wifi.node_head = 0;
790:   g_wifi.node_tail = kept % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
791:   g_wifi.node_count = kept;

1441:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1442:         }
1443: 
1444:       return;
1445:     }
1446: }

1448: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct wifi_pending_node *pending,
1449:                              struct wifi_net_notifications *notifications)
1450: {
1451:   const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node = &pending->node;
1452:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1453:   bool cp_owned[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1454:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *recycle;
1455:   uint32_t address = node->head;
1456:   uint8_t packet_added = 0;
1457:   unsigned int count;
1458:   irqstate_t flags;
1459: 
1460:   if (!pending->recycle_reserved || node->channel != 2 ||
1461:       node->num == 0 || node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1462:     {
1463:       return;
1464:     }
1465: 
1466:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1467:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1468:   recycle = &g_wifi.recycle[pending->recycle_index];
1469:   if (pending->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation ||
1470:       pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1471:     {
1472:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1473:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1474:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1475:       return;
1476:     }
1477:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1478: 
1479:   /* First pass validates the complete list without changing either core's
1480:    * ownership.  A malformed list is left untouched.
1481:    */
1482: 
1483:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1484:     {
1485:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
1486:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
1487:       uint32_t next;
1488:       unsigned int previous;
1489: 
1490:       if (address == 0)
1491:         {
1492:           goto invalid;
1493:         }
1494: 
1495:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
1496:         {
1497:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
1498:             {
1499:               goto invalid;
1500:             }
1501:         }
1502: 
1503:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
1504:         {
1505:           goto invalid;
1506:         }
1507: 
1508:       addresses[count] = address;
1509:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
1510:       if (tx != NULL)
1511:         {
1512:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
1513:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1514: 
1515:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0 ||
1516:               bk7258_wifi_cpdu_get_vif(ap_cpdu->flags) != tx->vif)
1517:             {
1518:               goto invalid;
1519:             }
1520: 
1521:           /* Completion is accepted by slot address even after role_epoch
1522:            * changes.  A role cannot start while any TX slot is busy, and
1523:            * rejecting a late completion here would leak the retained packet.
1524:            */
1525: 
1526:           cp_owned[count] = false;
1527:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
1528:         }
1529:       else
1530:         {
1531:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1532:           if (pending->generation !=
1533:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
1534:               !wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
1535:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL, NULL))
1536:             {
1537:               rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1538:               goto invalid;
1539:             }
1540: 
1541:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
1542:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1543:           cp_owned[count] = true;
1544:           next = cpdu.next;
1545:         }
1546: 
1547:       address = next;
1548:     }
1549: 
1550:   if (address != 0)
1551:     {
1552:       goto invalid;
1553:     }
1554: 
1555:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1556:     {
1557:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1558:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
1559:         {
1560:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1561:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1562:           uint8_t vif;
1563: 
1564:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1565:           if (pending->generation ==
1566:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() &&
1567:               pending->role_epoch == g_wifi.role_epoch &&
1568:               g_wifi.role_state == WIFI_ROLE_ACTIVE &&
1569:               g_wifi.active_role != WIFI_ROLE_NONE &&
1570:               wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index],
1571:                                  &vif) &&
1572:               vif == wifi_role_vif(g_wifi.active_role))
1573:             {
1574:               g_wifi.packets[index].role_epoch = pending->role_epoch;
1575:               packet_added++;
1576:             }
1577:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1578:         }
1579:     }
1580: 
1581:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1582:   if (pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1583:     {
1584:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1585:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1586:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1587:       return;
1588:     }
1589: 
1590:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
1591:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
1592:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1593:     {
1594:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1595:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1596:         {
1597:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
1598:         }
1599:     }
1600: 
1601:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
1602:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
1603:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1604:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1605:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1606:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
1607: 
1608:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1609:     {
1610:       if (!cp_owned[count])
1611:         {
1612:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
1613: 
1614:           notifications->tx_packets[notifications->tx_count++] = tx->packet;
1615:           tx->packet = NULL;
1616:           tx->active = false;
1617:           tx->transport_rejected = false;
1618:         }
1619:     }
1620:   if (packet_added != 0)
1621:     {
1622:       notifications->rxready = true;
1623:     }
1624:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1625:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1626:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1627:   return;
1628: 
1629: invalid:
1630:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1631:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1632:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1633:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1634: }

1637: static int wifi_mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1638:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
1639: {
1640:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
1641:   struct wifi_pending_node *pending;
1642:   irqstate_t flags;
1643: 
1644:   (void)ack_flags;
1645:   (void)arg;
1646:   memcpy(&node, message, sizeof(node));
1647:   if (node.num == 0 || node.num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1648:     {
1649:       return -EINVAL;
1650:     }
1651: 
1652:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1653:   if (g_wifi.node_count == WIFI_NODE_QUEUE ||
1654:       (node.channel == 2 &&
1655:        g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE))
1656:     {
1657:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1658:       return -EAGAIN;
1659:     }
1660: 
1661:   pending = &g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_tail];
1662:   memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
1663:   pending->node = node;
1664:   pending->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
1665:   pending->role_epoch = g_wifi.role_epoch;
1666:   if (node.channel == 2)
1667:     {
1668:       struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry =
1669:         &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_tail];
1670: 
1671:       memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1672:       entry->generation = pending->generation;
1673:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_RESERVED;
1674:       pending->recycle_index = g_wifi.recycle_tail;
1675:       pending->recycle_reserved = true;
1676:       g_wifi.recycle_tail = (g_wifi.recycle_tail + 1) %
1677:                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1678:       g_wifi.recycle_count++;
1679:     }
1680: 
1681:   g_wifi.node_tail = (g_wifi.node_tail + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1682:   g_wifi.node_count++;
1683:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1684:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1685:   return OK;
1686: }

1698: static int wifi_worker(int argc, char **argv)
1699: {
1700:   (void)argc;
1701:   (void)argv;
1702:   g_worker_result = OK;
1703:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.ready_sem);
1704: 
1705:   for (;;)
1706:     {
1707:       struct wifi_pending_node pending;
1708:       struct wifi_net_notifications notifications;
1709:       irqstate_t flags;
1710: 
1711:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.work_sem,
1712:                                            WIFI_WORK_INTERVAL);
1713:       memset(&notifications, 0, sizeof(notifications));
1714:       (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();
1715:       wifi_collect_rejected_tx(&notifications);
1716:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1717:       for (;;)
1718:         {
1719:           if (bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() !=
1720:               g_wifi.reset_generation)
1721:             {
1722:               (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();
1723:             }
1724: 
1725:           nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1726:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1727:           if (g_wifi.node_count == 0)
1728:             {
1729:               rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1730:               nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1731:               break;
1732:             }
1733: 
1734:           pending = g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head];
1735:           g_wifi.node_head = (g_wifi.node_head + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1736:           g_wifi.node_count--;
1737:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1738:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1739:           if (pending.generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1740:             {
1741:               if (pending.recycle_reserved)
1742:                 {
1743:                   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1744:                   g_wifi.recycle[pending.recycle_index].state =
1745:                     WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1746:                   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1747:                 }
1748:             }
1749:           else if (pending.node.channel == 0)
1750:             {
1751:               wifi_handle_command_list(&pending.node,
1752:                                        pending.generation);
1753:             }
1754:           else if (pending.node.channel == 2)
1755:             {
1756:               wifi_handle_data(&pending, &notifications);
1757:             }
1758:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1759:         }
1760: 
1761:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1762:       wifi_notify_network(&notifications);
1763:       wifi_notify_carrier();
1764:     }
1765: 
1766:   return OK;
1767: }

1769: static int wifi_ifup(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower)

1775:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);

1778:   carrier = g_wifi.role_state == WIFI_ROLE_ACTIVE &&
1779:             (g_wifi.active_role == WIFI_ROLE_STA || g_wifi.ap_started);

1782:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);

1787: static int wifi_stop_active_role(void)
1788: {
1789:   struct bk7258_wifi_ap_status_response ap_status;
1790:   enum wifi_role role;
1791:   enum wifi_role_state previous_state;
1792:   int32_t status = 0;
1793:   uint16_t result_length = 0;
1794:   irqstate_t flags;
1795:   int ret;
1796: 
1797:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1798:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1799:   role = g_wifi.active_role;
1800:   if (role == WIFI_ROLE_NONE)
1801:     {
1802:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1803:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1804:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
1805:       return OK;
1806:     }
1807:   if (g_wifi.role_state == WIFI_ROLE_STOPPING)
1808:     {
1809:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1810:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1811:       return -EBUSY;
1812:     }
1813: 
1814:   previous_state = g_wifi.role_state;
1815:   g_wifi.role_state = WIFI_ROLE_STOPPING;
1816:   g_wifi.tx_gate = false;
1817:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1818:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1819:   wifi_set_carrier(false);
1820:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_wifi.role_sem) == OK)
1821:     {
1822:     }
1823: 
1824:   if (role == WIFI_ROLE_STA)
1825:     {
1826:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_DISCONNECT, NULL, 0,
1827:                          NULL, 0, NULL);
1828:     }
1829:   else
1830:     {
1831:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_STOP, NULL, 0,
1832:                          &status, sizeof(status), &result_length);
1833:       if (ret >= 0 && result_length != sizeof(status))
1834:         {
1835:           ret = -EPROTO;
1836:         }
1837:       else if (ret >= 0 && status != 0)
1838:         {
1839:           ret = status;
1840:         }
1841:       if (ret >= 0)
1842:         {
1843:           ret = wifi_ap_status_query(&ap_status);
1844:           if (ret >= 0 && !ap_status.started)
1845:             {
1846:               wifi_role_deactivate(WIFI_ROLE_SOFTAP);
1847:               return OK;
1848:             }
1849:         }
1850:     }
1851: 
1852:   if (ret >= 0)
1853:     {
1854:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.role_sem,
1855:                                             WIFI_ROLE_STOP_TIMEOUT);
1856:     }
1857:   if (ret == -ETIMEDOUT && role == WIFI_ROLE_STA)
1858:     {
1859:       bool connected;
1860: 
1861:       if (wifi_sta_status_connected(&connected) == OK && !connected)
1862:         {
1863:           wifi_role_deactivate(WIFI_ROLE_STA);
1864:           return OK;
1865:         }
1866:     }
1867:   if (ret < 0)
1868:     {
1869:       bool carrier;
1870: 
1871:       nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1872:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1873:       if (g_wifi.active_role == role &&
1874:           g_wifi.role_state == WIFI_ROLE_STOPPING && ret != -ETIMEDOUT)
1875:         {
1876:           g_wifi.role_state = previous_state;
1877:           g_wifi.tx_gate = previous_state == WIFI_ROLE_ACTIVE &&
1878:                            g_wifi.admin_up &&
1879:                            (role == WIFI_ROLE_STA || g_wifi.ap_started);
1880:         }
1881:       carrier = g_wifi.tx_gate;
1882:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1883:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1884:       wifi_set_carrier(carrier);
1885:     }
1886: 
1887:   return ret;
1888: }

1890: static int wifi_ifdown(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower)
1891: {
1892:   irqstate_t flags;
1893:   int ret;

1897:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);

1899:   g_wifi.admin_up = false;
1900:   g_wifi.tx_gate = false;
1901:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1902:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1903:   wifi_set_carrier(false);
1904:   return ret;
1905: }

1907: static int wifi_transmit(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower, netpkt_t *packet)
1908: {
1909:   struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = NULL;
1910:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
1911:   uint8_t vif;
1912:   uint32_t role_epoch;
1913:   unsigned int length;
1914:   unsigned int i;
1915:   int ret;
1916: 
1917:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1918:   length = netpkt_getdatalen(lower, packet);
1919:   if (!g_wifi.carrier || !g_wifi.tx_gate ||
1920:       g_wifi.role_state != WIFI_ROLE_ACTIVE ||
1921:       g_wifi.active_role == WIFI_ROLE_NONE ||
1922:       !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1923:     {
1924:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1925:       return -ENETDOWN;
1926:     }
1927:   if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME)
1928:     {
1929:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1930:       return -EMSGSIZE;
1931:     }
1932: 
1933:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
1934:     {
1935:       if (!g_wifi.tx[i].active && !g_wifi.tx[i].transport_pending)
1936:         {
1937:           tx = &g_wifi.tx[i];
1938:           break;
1939:         }
1940:     }
1941:   if (tx == NULL)
1942:     {
1943:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1944:       return -EBUSY;
1945:     }
1946: 
1947:   memset(&tx->pbuf, 0, sizeof(tx->pbuf));
1948:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1949:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu));
1950:   vif = wifi_role_vif(g_wifi.active_role);
1951:   role_epoch = g_wifi.role_epoch;
1952:   tx->pbuf.payload = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)tx->frame;
1953:   tx->pbuf.tot_len = length;
1954:   tx->pbuf.len = length;
1955:   tx->pbuf.type_internal = WIFI_PBUF_TYPE_RAM;
1956:   tx->pbuf.ref = 1;
1957:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + length;
1958:   cpdu->type_dst = 2u;
1959:   cpdu->flags = bk7258_wifi_cpdu_set_vif(cpdu->flags, vif);
1960:   ret = netpkt_copyout(lower, tx->frame, packet, length, 0);
1961:   if (ret < 0)
1962:     {
1963:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1964:       return ret;
1965:     }
1966: 
1967:   tx->packet = packet;
1968:   tx->active = true;
1969:   tx->transport_pending = true;
1970:   tx->transport_rejected = false;
1971:   tx->vif = vif;
1972:   tx->role_epoch = role_epoch;
1973:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, 2,
1974:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
1975:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
1976:                        wifi_tx_transport_complete, tx);
1977:   if (ret < 0)
1978:     {
1979:       tx->packet = NULL;
1980:       tx->active = false;
1981:       tx->transport_pending = false;
1982:     }
1983:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1984:   return ret;
1985: }

1987: static netpkt_t *wifi_receive(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower)
1988: {
1989:   struct wifi_rx_packet *rx;
1990:   netpkt_t *packet;
1991:   irqstate_t flags;
1992: 
1993:   packet = netpkt_alloc(lower, NETPKT_RX);
1994:   if (packet == NULL)
1995:     {
1996:       return NULL;
1997:     }
1998: 
1999:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
2000:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
2001:   while (g_wifi.packet_count != 0 &&
2002:          g_wifi.packets[g_wifi.packet_head].role_epoch != g_wifi.role_epoch)
2003:     {
2004:       g_wifi.packet_head = (g_wifi.packet_head + 1) % WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;

47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

CP AP start/stop are synchronous and update `WIFI_AP_STARTED_BIT` before returning; AP-side start and stop confirmations are followed by authoritative status queries at [bk7258_wifi.c:2144](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:2144) and [bk7258_wifi.c:1841](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1841), covering lost lifecycle indications.
- Carrier notification is serialized safely: state changes occur under the driver spinlock, wake the worker, and `netdev_lower_carrier_on/off()` runs outside that lock at [bk7258_wifi.c:477](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:477) and [bk7258_wifi.c:1698](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1698).

**Hardware-Only Residual Risks**
- Over-the-air SoftAP beaconing, WPA2 association, client DHCP leases, and STA reconnect timing still require target-board validation.
- CP reset during an in-flight DMA TX intentionally quarantines that TX slot because ownership completion cannot be proven. Repeated reset fault injection could consume the finite eight-slot TX pool; this is distinct from normal completion/reconnect operation.
- Event ordering and mailbox ACK behavior under RF loss, rapid role cycling, and CP reset remain hardware stress-test risks.
